_comment: When this attacks a hero, if you have less {h} than them, the crowd cheers you. If you've been cheered this turn, this gets +1{p}. Was SET_FLAG/FLAG_SET on a private flag — red used CROWD_CHEERS and blue CROWD_CHEERS_ACTIVE, so neither could see a cheer from the other or from any other source.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.
